description: This Java source file defines a class implementing a default UUID-based external event idempotency key generator within the Fineract project. The class is annotated as a Spring component and provides a method to generate unique keys for business events.

classes.name: DefaultExternalEventIdempotencyKeyGenerator
classes.description: A Spring component class that generates unique string keys for external events using UUIDs, implementing the ExternalEventIdempotencyKeyGenerator interface.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a unique idempotency key for a given BusinessEvent by returning a new UUID string.
